papers.title_en: FlexSpIM: An Event-Based Digital Compute-In-Memory Accelerator with Flexible Operand Resolution and Layer-Wise Hybrid Stationarity
papers.authors: Nicolas Chauvaux, Adrian Kneip, Charlotte Frenkel
papers.evidence: 数字存内计算加速器，混合数据流与操作数复用
papers.tldr: 面向边缘视觉的脉冲神经网络CIM加速器虽能实现微秒级推理与超低功耗，但电路与系统层面灵活性不足，难以适配多样负载。FlexSpIM提出一种数字CIM架构，支持任意操作数位宽与形状，并在统一存储中融合权重与神经元膜电位。它实现层间混合权重/输出固定数据流，最大化操作数复用并减少片内片外数据搬运。40nm CMOS原型验证了可重构位宽下的高能效与吞吐，在IBM DVS手势数据集上达95.8%准确率，大规模系统中能耗与延迟分别降低45%和52%。
papers.abstract_en: Compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerators for spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a promising solution for achieving $μ$s-level inference latency and ultra-low energy in edge vision applications. However, their limited flexibility at both circuit and system levels restricts their deployment across diverse workloads. This work introduces FlexSpIM, a digital CIM architecture supporting arbitrary operand resolution and shape within a unified storage for weights and neuron states (i.e., membrane potentials). These circuit-level capabilities enable a layer-level hybrid weight- and output-stationary dataflow, maximizing operand reuse and reducing costly on- and off-chip data movement during SNN execution. Measurement results from a fabricated FlexSpIM prototype in 40-nm CMOS demonstrate competitive 1-bit-normalized energy efficiency and higher throughput compared with prior fixed-precision digital CIM-based SNN accelerators, while providing bitwise resolution reconfiguration. Evaluated on the IBM DVS gesture dataset, FlexSpIM achieves 95.8% accuracy while enabling up to 45% energy and 52% latency reductions in large-scale systems compared with fixed stationarity approaches.

papers.title_en: Differentiable Partitioning with Placement and Hybrid Bonding Terminal Awareness for Optimized 3D Placement
papers.authors: Liwen Jiang, Xu Shi, Rufeng Xiao, Changhao Yan, Rujun Jiang, Zhiang Wang, Keren Zhu
papers.evidence: 混合键合三维集成电路层分配与端子感知三维布局
papers.tldr: 面向混合键合3D-IC，层分配需联合决定3D线长与混合键合端子（HBT）分配，传统方法难以兼顾。本文提出可微分划分框架，将离散层分配松弛为连续概率，并用Dual-Max 3D线长模型刻画各层HPWL。同时以端子感知切割惩罚抑制HBT拥塞区跨die线网，用局部平衡约束均衡各层网格密度。在OpenROAD基准上，D2D HPWL较两种min-cut基线平均降低2.0%，较先进3D布局器降低12.1%，并开源流程。
papers.abstract_en: Research on 3D-ICs physical design has expanded rapidly in recent years. Hybrid bonding-enabled 3D integrated circuits (3D-ICs) offer substantial benefits in interconnect scaling and system integration, yet tier assignment remains challenging because it jointly determines 3D wirelength and hybrid bonding terminal (HBT) assignment. This paper presents a differentiable partitioning framework that directly optimizes placement-aware tier assignment for 3D-ICs through gradient-based optimization. Discrete tier assignment is relaxed to continuous probabilities, and a Dual-Max 3D wirelength model is introduced to capture per-tier half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL). In addition, a terminal-aware cutsize penalty selectively suppresses cross-die nets in HBT-congested regions, and a local balance constraint enforces grid-cell density equilibrium across tiers. Experimental results on OpenROAD benchmarks show that our method reduces D2D HPWL by 2.0% on average over two min-cut baselines and by 12.1% over the state-of-the-art 3D placer. We open-source our partition code with 3D placement flow to support reproducibility.
